name: TheraPlatform
short_description: EHR with built-in teletherapy for mental health, speech, occupational and physical therapists; plans from $39/month, with AI notes optional.
long_description: TheraPlatform is an EHR and practice-management system with built-in teletherapy for solo and group practices in mental and behavioral health, speech-language pathology, occupational therapy and physical therapy. Teletherapy carries no extra fee. It includes templates for intakes, assessments, treatment plans, SOAP and progress notes and discharge summaries, plus insurance claim filing (electronic claims $0.25 each). Optional AI notes draft a structured note from typed keywords, dictation or a transcript of a telehealth session; the vendor says recordings can be deleted at any time and client data is not used to train external models. Wiley treatment planners are an add-on. TheraPlatform's FAQ says plans start at $39/month for a solo provider with no setup fees or contracts, with a 30-day free trial and no credit card, and that it signs a BAA. Plan-level prices on its own pages are inconsistent, so confirm current tiers on the pricing page.
one_liner: Therapy EHR with built-in video sessions for mental health and rehab therapists, from $39/month.
best_for: Teletherapy practices that want video built into the EHR at no extra fee
Mixed practices with counselors, speech-language pathologists, OTs or PTs on one system
Solo therapists who want no setup fees or contracts and a 30-day trial without a credit card
Clinicians who want optional AI notes from telehealth session transcripts
not_for: Prescribers: e-prescribing is not documented on TheraPlatform's own feature pages
Agencies needing state reporting or CCBHC workflows
Buyers who need a clear published price for each plan tier before signing up
